intent_contract.text: 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create one independent, complex, photographically plausible Stonepunk concept for later image generation and rendered-pixel testing, using the supplied portrait strictly as an appearance-only reference for one clearly adult subject. For this arm, Stonepunk is an agent interpretation of a speculative technological culture whose working mechanisms, architecture, clothing hardware, and energy-reading system are visibly built from carved stone and integrated minerals rather than a requester-supplied definition.

A cinematic Stonepunk environmental portrait inside a tidal observatory carved from colossal concentric basalt rings. An unmistakably adult woman, using the supplied portrait only for facial appearance, has long near-black wavy hair, warm brown almond-shaped eyes, softly arched brows, a slim oval face, and natural rose lips. She wears a black woven-flax mantle armored with overlapping polished-shale plates and stone fasteners. At blue hour she locks a fist-sized quartz chronometer into a hand-cranked stone astrolabe. Her left hand braces the crystal socket while her right turns a carved granite crank. Interlocking basalt gears, counterweighted monolith arms, and grooved circular tracks visibly transmit the motion: one outer ring has shifted open toward a breaking wave. Veins of quartz embedded through the mechanism glow and trace measured tide lines across raised carvings. Salt spray catches the mineral light; wet stone, wind-tossed hair, and precise hand contact ground the scene as physically photographed working technology.

obligation.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, wardrobe, and visual style. In one still, keep a calm low-expression baseline visibly stable while one concrete, quiet practical action helps one identifiable trusted adult counterpart and leaves an already-visible helpful consequence for that same counterpart. Add only one localized warmth leak, such as slight lower-lid easing, a restrained brow release, a fractional mouth-corner softening, or reduced tension in the hand or shoulder nearest the target. Optional outward support may use economical gesture, stable upright posture, a neat simple silhouette, restrained grooming, or a muted/cool-neutral palette, but these are conventions rather than requirements. Do not assign fixed hair color, eye color, hairstyle, costume, gender, occupation, gaze direction, camera angle, or prop, and do not let expressionlessness, competence, beauty, a cool palette, or a caring object substitute for the same-target action and consequence. Preserve the counterpart's autonomy; avoid hostile denial, shy withdrawal, possessive control, broad open affection, or an abrupt personality switch.
